- [Hyatt Regency](https://www.hyatt.com/search/hotels/en-US/New%20Brunswick%2C%20New%20Jersey%2C%20United%20States?checkinDate=2026-10-28&checkoutDate=2026-10-29&rooms=1&adults=1&kids=0&rate=Standard&accessibilityCheck=false)
